blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce CoLa3D, a simple and effective model for composable 3D scene decomposition that, given a single whole-scene latent from either a single image or an existing scene mesh as input, directly outputs a set of object meshes with consistent spatial layout that can be assembled back into a coherent scene. CoLa3D introduces a novel paradigm for 3D scene decomposition within a shared whole-scene latent, unlike alternatives that perform per-object generation in canonical spaces and then glue the objects back together with fragile pose and scale estimation. The network is a lightweight, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer that accepts various types of queries, including 2D masks, 3D points, and learnable queries, and learns to decompose the scene into objects in a compact latent space. On both synthetic and real-world datasets, CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on composable 3D scene decomposition, substantially improving global scene-level consistency and object-level quality while running 2 times faster and using less than 1% of SAM 3D's training data. Visible depth on par with MoGe2 further confirms that latent decomposition preserves accurate visible scene geometry while producing physically complete, decomposable object meshes.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 CoLa3D, 一种简单有效的可相容的 三维场景分解模型, 通过单个图像或现有场景网的单个整体场景潜伏作为输入, 直接输出一组具有相容空间布局的物体间歇, 可以重新组装成一个相容的场景 。 CoLa3D引入了在共享的全场潜在范围内进行3D场景分解的新范式,与在犬形空间中进行每个对象生成,然后用脆弱的姿势和尺度估计将物体粘接回一起的替代品不同. 网络是一个轻而易举,灵活而可伸缩的基于查询的变压器,它接受各种类型的查询,包括2D口罩,3D分,以及可学习的查询,并学会将场景分解为紧凑的潜在空间中的物体. 在合成和现实世界数据集上,CoLa3D在可相容的3D场景分解上实现了最先进的性能,大大提高了全局场景水平的一致性和对象级别质量,同时运行速度快了2倍并使用了不到1%的SAM 3D的训练数据. 与MoGe2对等的可见深度进一步证实,潜在分解在产生物理上完整可分解的物体间隙的同时,保留了准确可见的场景几何.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
We consider the problem of composable 3D scene decomposition from either an existing 3D mesh or a single image.
The output represents the scene as a coherent whole and a collection of physically plausible 3D instances ,
namely object-level meshes together with their spatial arrangement ( fig. 1 ).
This is the form in which our physical world is organized:
a living room,
for example,
is not merely a pile of whole scene geometry,
but a structured arrangement of sofas, coffee tables, lamps, and other objects.
Recovering such a composable 3D scene is important for embodied agents that reason jointly about objects and their relationships to interact with them in the physical world [ 23 , 18 , 9 ] ,
as well as for AR/VR systems that require editable and interactive scene representations [ 43 , 73 , 78 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们考虑从现有的3D网格或单个图像中分解出可相容的3D场景的问题.
产出代表了整个场景 以及一系列实际可行的三维实例
即物体级中间层及其空间安排(图1)。
这就是我们物质世界的组织形式:
一个客厅,
例如,
不仅仅是一堆场景几何
但沙发、咖啡桌、灯具和其他物体的结构安排
恢复这种可调和的三维场景,对于共同解释物体及其关系以在物理世界中与它们互动的被体现的物剂十分重要[23、18、9],
以及需要可编辑和互动场景展示的AR/VR系统[43、73、78]。

blocks.en:
Traditional 3D decomposition,
also known as instance segmentation ,
operates on raw 3D observations such as point clouds [ 46 , 88 , 35 , 51 , 91 , 38 ] ,
but often struggles when the geometry is noisy or incomplete.
Another line of work reconstructs composable 3D scenes from images or RGB-D scans,
but typically relies on retrieval-based pipelines [ 2 , 22 , 17 ] or per-scene optimization [ 90 , 77 , 73 , 74 ] .
These methods are difficult to scale in practice due to the limited coverage of retrieval libraries and the computational cost of test-time optimization.
These methods either falter on noisy geometry or rely on costly external pipelines, motivating learning-based composable reconstruction from images.
blocks.zh:
传统的 三维分解,
也被称为实例分割,
在点云等原始三维观测上运行 [46, 88, 35, 51, 91, 38],
但往往在几何学很吵或不完整时挣扎.
另一行工作从图像或RGB-D扫描中重建了可堆肥的3D场景,
但一般依赖基于取回的管道[2,22,17]或每地景优化[90,77,73,74].
由于检索库的覆盖范围有限以及测试时间优化的计算成本,这些方法在实践中难以推广.
这些方法要么在吵闹的几何上摇摆不定,要么依靠昂贵的外部管道,推动从图像中进行以学习为基础的堆肥重建。

blocks.en:
Recent progress in 3D object generators [ 84 , 86 , 75 , 63 , 27 , 60 , 76 ] and 2D segmenters [ 20 , 47 , 4 ] has made composable 3D scene reconstruction from sparse views, or even a single image, increasingly plausible.
Recent contributions like MIDI [ 16 ] , CAST [ 80 ] , SceneGen [ 39 ] , and SAM 3D [ 6 ] follow a common recipe: they first segment objects in 2D image space using SAM [ 20 ] , and then condition 3D generators on these masks to reconstruct object assets.
While promising,
the recomposed scene often suffers from spatial inconsistency and incoherence, as illustrated in fig. 3 and fig. 4 .
The core difficulty is that object geometry and scene-level scale, position, and pose are not jointly modeled in a shared 3D coordinate frame:
object generators usually operate in canonical spaces, and the relative layout has to be glued back across separately-generated object latents.
Very recent methods [ 16 , 39 , 6 , 30 ] mitigate this issue by introducing cross-attention between object latents or by conditioning on global scene features,
but they still couple objects only indirectly rather than decomposing a scene into object representations in the same coordinate frame.
Moreover, these approaches must generate multiple object latents via diffusion models,
making them computationally slow.
blocks.zh:

最近的贡献如MIDI [16], CAST [80], SceneGen [39],和SAM 3D [6] 遵循一个共同的配方:它们首先使用SAM [20]在2D图像空间中分出对象,然后在这些口罩上附加3D生成器以重建对象资产.
虽然很有希望,

核心难度是,对象几何和场景级的尺度,位置,和姿势不在一个共享的3D坐标框中共同建模:
对象生成器通常运行在犬形空间中,相对布局必须被粘回到单独生成的物体潜伏处.
最近的方法[16、39、6、30]通过在物体潜伏物之间引入交叉注意或在全球场景特征上设定条件来缓解这一问题,
但它们仍然只能间接地将一个场景分解成同一坐标框中的物体表示.
此外,这些方法必须通过扩散模型产生多种物体的潜在作用,
使他们计算缓慢。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce a novel paradigm for joint object decomposition within a shared scene latent, instead of independent per-object generation in canonical spaces.
We do so by introducing Co mposable La tent 3D decomposition ( CoLa3D ),
a feed-forward neural network that predicts a set of object latents from a single whole-scene latent in the scene coordinate frame,
which are then decoded in parallel to produce individual meshes,
as well as their recomposed whole scene mesh.
Because its decomposition is performed in a shared scene coordinate frame, the decoded individual meshes are naturally more spatially consistent with the global scene geometry.
Remarkably,
its outputs exhibit less interpenetration and appear more physically plausible than MIDI, SceneGen, PartCrafter, and SAM 3D,
making them readily usable in physical simulators for downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了一种新颖的范式,在共享场景潜想中进行联合对象分解,而不是在犬形空间中独立地进行每个对象的生成.
我们介绍 共可移动拉帐篷 三维分解(CoLa3D),
一个向导神经网络, 预测一组物体的潜伏 从单一的全场潜伏 在场景坐标框架,
然后同时解码 以产生单个的网状,
以及他们重新组合的整个场景网格。
由于它的分解是在一个共享的场景坐标框中完成的,被解码出的个人网格自然在空间上更符合全球场景几何.
值得注意的是,
其产出与MIDI、SceneGen、PartCrafter和SAM 3D相比,其互通性较低,在物理上更可信,
使其易于用于下游任务的物理模拟器。

blocks.en:
We instantiate this idea with a flexible query-based decomposition transformer that performs all object decomposition in a single forward pass.
Concretely,
CoLa3D accepts as input (i) the whole-scene latent, and (ii) promptable queries ( e.g. , 2D masks, 3D points, or purely learnable queries) that interact with the latent tokens,
and produces a set of object latents for a generative decoder to produce per-object meshes.
To further improve generalization to novel categories and scenes,
we incorporate 3D semantic features from Utonia [ 87 ] and 2D semantic features from DINOv3 [ 52 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们用一个灵活的基于查询的分解变压器来即时处理这个想法,这种分解变压器在单个前行通道中实现所有对象分解.
具体地说,
CoLa3D接受作为输入(一)全场潜入,和(二)与潜入物相互作用的可即时查询(如2D口罩,3D分或纯粹可学习的查询),
并产生一组物体潜伏物 一个基因解码器 产生每个对象的 meshes。
为了进一步改善对小说类别和场景的概括,
我们吸收了来自Utonia的3D语义特征[87]和来自DINov3的2D语义特征[52].

blocks.en:
To evaluate our model,
we create challenging benchmarks on both synthetic (3D-FRONT [ 11 ] and MetaScenes [ 83 ] ) and real-world datasets (Replica [ 56 ] and ScanNet++ [ 81 ] ).
CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on both object asset quality and global scene consistency.
More impressively, compared with SAM 3D [ 6 ] , which was trained on a large-scale dataset with SAM-based priors and substantial policy tuning and computational resources,
CoLa3D shows better results using less than 1 % 1\% of SAM 3D’s training data, demonstrating the effectiveness of our latent decomposition paradigm.
We hope this work will inspire future research on composable 3D scene generation.
blocks.zh:
为了评估我们的模型
我们为合成(3D-FRONT [11]和MetaScens [83])和现实世界数据集(Replica [56]和ScanNet++ [81])制定具有挑战性的基准。
CoLa3D在物体资产质量和全球场景一致性上都实现了最先进的性能.
更令人印象深刻的是,与SAM 3D[6]相比,SAM 3D[6]在基于SAM的前科和大量政策调整和计算资源的基础上接受了大规模数据集的培训,
CoLa3D 使用不到1%的 SAM 3D 训练数据显示更好的效果, 证明了我们潜在的分解模式的有效性 。
我们希望这项工作能激励未来对可堆肥的3D场景生成的研究.

blocks.en:
Recent promptable 3D segmenters like Point-SAM [ 91 ] , Locate 3D [ 38 ] , and Particulate [ 25 ] also build on query-based architectures, but they operate on raw 3D observations.
In contrast, CoLa3D operates on a compact generative 3D latent.
This allows CoLa3D to extract object-level meshes, rather than segmentation masks, from encoded meshes or single-image generated scene latents.
blocks.zh:
最近的可快速的3D分路器如Point-SAM [91],Locate 3D [38],和Particulation [25] 也以基于查询的架构为基础,但是它们运行在原始的3D观测上.
相形之下,CoLa3D在紧凑的基因3D潜伏上运行.
这使得CoLa3D能够从编码的meshes或由单相成像生成的场景潜伏物中取出对象级的meshes,而不是分化口罩.

blocks.en:
To summarize, we make the following contributions:
(1) We introduce a novel paradigm, CoLa3D, for composable 3D scene decomposition: it obtains object latents from one whole-scene latent in a shared scene coordinate frame and decodes them in parallel into per-object meshes.
(2) We design a lightweight query-based decomposition transformer that performs latent-space object extraction in a single forward pass, using 2D mask, 3D point, and learnable queries.
(3) We show that CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets, outperforming strong baselines such as MIDI [ 16 ] , SceneGen [ 39 ] , PartCrafter [ 30 ] , and SAM 3D [ 6 ] in both object quality and global scene consistency.
blocks.zh:
总之,我们作出以下贡献:
(1)我们引入了一种新的范式CoLa3D,用于可相容的3D场景分解:它从共享场景坐标框中一个整体-场景潜想得到物体潜想,并平行地解码成每个对象的 meshes.
(2)我们设计一个轻量级的基于查询的分解变压器,在单向前行的通道中进行潜在-空间物体取出,使用2D口罩,3D点和可学习的查询.
(3)我们显示,CoLa3D在合成和现实世界数据集上都实现了最先进的性能,在对象质量和全球场景一致性上都超过了MIDI [16],SceneGen [39],PartCrafter [30],SAM 3D [6]等强基线.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
3D Reconstruction and Generation. Recovering 3D geometry from images is a long-standing problem in computer vision.
Classical reconstruction pipelines such as COLMAP [ 49 , 50 ] chain multiple stages—structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo—to estimate camera poses and dense geometry, whereas recent feed-forward models [ 71 , 7 , 72 , 65 , 69 , 29 , 66 ] unify these stages into an end-to-end network.
Beyond reconstruction, generative 3D models synthesize assets from learned priors with point, voxel, implicit, or Gaussian representations [ 42 , 48 , 44 , 40 , 55 , 19 ] , and recent foundation 3D generators [ 86 , 75 , 76 , 59 , 60 , 61 , 27 ] further produce high-quality assets in compact 3D latent spaces [ 84 ] .
However, these holistic generators do not expose editable instance-level structure.
Part-aware 3D generation [ 33 , 5 , 13 , 79 , 58 ] addresses object decomposition but focuses on single objects rather than scene-level instances.
We instead target scene -level 3D instance decomposition.

blocks.en:
Scene Decomposition. Scene decomposition aims to obtain a composable 3D scene made of individual object instances.
Traditional 3D decomposition performs instance segmentation on raw 3D observations [ 51 , 21 , 91 , 38 , 25 ] , but they are sensitive to noisy observations and output masks instead of complete object meshes.
Recently, generative scene decomposition instead targets object-level geometry together with a coherent global layout.
Staged pipelines first segment scene components and then retrieve, reconstruct, or optimize them separately [ 22 , 14 , 12 , 90 , 77 , 73 , 74 , 41 , 92 , 1 , 15 , 80 , 89 ] .
They are modular but often depend on external segmentation, per-object generation, and layout refinement, which can lead to inconsistent pose, scale, and contact.
Joint models couple object geometry, pose, and instance assignment during generation [ 10 , 16 , 28 , 67 , 39 , 6 , 82 , 31 ] , yet objects are still generated in separate latents and need extra pose and scale estimation.
PartCrafter [ 30 ] jointly denoises per-object latent in a global frame, but object poses are still implicitly modeled through attention.
In contrast, our method decomposes a single whole-scene latent into globally aligned object latents in a feed-forward manner, avoiding separate object generation and per-scene optimization. Inter-object spatial relations are thus naturally encoded in the shared latent.
blocks.zh:
相会分解. 场景分解旨在得到由单个物体实例所制作的可相容的3D场景.
传统的3D分解在生的3D观测上进行实例分解[51,21,91,38,25],但它们对吵闹的观测和输出口罩而不是完整的物体网格很敏感.
最近,基因场景分解,取而代之的是瞄准物体级几何,同时具有连贯的全球布局.
已分阶段的管线第一段场景组件,然后分别取回,重建或优化[22,14,12,90,77,73,74,41,92,1,15,80,89].
它们是模块化的,但往往取决于外部分化、每个物体生成和布局的完善,这可能导致布局、规模和接触不一致。
联合模型对偶对象几何,姿势,以及生成过程中的实例分配[10, 16, 28, 67, 39, 6, 82, 31],然而物体仍然在单独的潜伏中生成,需要额外的姿势和尺度估计.
PartCrrafter [30] 在全球框架内共同将每个物体都潜入其中,但物体的外观仍然通过注意被暗示为模型.
相形之下,我们的方法将一个单一的全场潜伏物分解成全球对齐的物体潜伏物,从而避免了单独的物体生成和每场优化. 因此,物体间空间关系自然地被编码在共同的潜想中。

blocks.en:
Query-Based Models. Query-based models predict object sets through learnable queries and have become a standard formulation for detection and segmentation [ 3 , 93 , 85 , 8 , 24 ] .
Recent promptable 3D models also use points or masks as queries for 3D segmentation [ 91 , 37 , 94 ] .
Related object-centric models also learn latent slots to represent scene entities [ 36 , 53 , 54 ] .
Our method uses queries as latent extractors: each query interacts with a compact foundation-model scene latent and outputs an object latent that can be decoded into a mesh within the shared scene coordinate frame.
blocks.zh:
腾讯-腾讯模式. 基于查询的模型通过可学习的查询来预测对象集,并已成为检测和分化的标准配方[3,93,85,8,24].
近期可快速的3D模型还使用分点或口罩作为3D分块的查询[91,37,94].
相关的以物体为中心的模型还学习了潜在的插槽来代表场景实体[36,53,54].
我们的方法将查询作为潜在的提取器:每个查询都与紧凑的地基模型场景进行交互,并输出一个可以解码成共享场景坐标框架内的网格的物体.

blocks.en:
Given a single image 𝑰 s \bm{I}^{s} or an existing 3D scene mesh ℳ s \mathcal{M}^{s} from AI-generated, scanned, or artist-created sources,
our goal is to obtain a composable 3D scene as a set of object meshes { ℳ ^ k o } k = 1 K \{\hat{\mathcal{M}}^{o}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} with their correct spatial layout,
where K K is the number of objects in the scene.
Here, we introduce CoLa3D,
a feed-forward neural network that
predicts a set of object latents from a single whole-scene latent in a global latent space ,
which are then decoded in parallel to produce per-object meshes.
The designed query-based decomposition transformer is efficient, flexible, and scalable.
It accepts various types of queries and operates directly on the compact 3D scene latent (as illustrated in Figure 2 ),
instead of segmenting the scene in 2D and lifting each instance separately as in prior methods [ 16 , 39 , 6 ] ,
or performing segmentation on raw 3D observations [ 51 , 21 , 91 , 38 , 25 ] .

CoLa3D is built upon TRELLIS.2 [ 76 ] ,
a state-of-the-art image-to-3D generator with a compact structured 3D latent space.
The proposed latent decomposition paradigm is not specific to TRELLIS.2
and should be applicable to other foundational 3D generators,
such as Hunyuan3D [ 59 , 60 ] .

blocks.en:
Attention Blocks. Following recent query-based segmentors [ 20 , 25 , 38 , 26 ] ,
we apply a stack of attention blocks to let queries interact with the scene latent and specialize into instance-level representations.
In each block,
we first perform self-attention over query tokens { 𝒒 k } k = 1 K \{\bm{q}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} .
Then,
updated query tokens { 𝒒 ^ k } k = 1 K \{\hat{\bm{q}}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} and latent tokens { 𝒛 i s } i = 1 L lat \{\bm{z}^{s}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{L_{\text{lat}}} cross-attend to the DINOv3 [ 52 ] features 𝒇 img \bm{f}^{\text{img}} , grounding the 3D representations with 2D semantic cues.
Finally,
alternating Latent-to-Query and Query-to-Latent cross-attention are performed to flow information between them.
We apply 3D RoPE [ 57 , 68 ] to the query self-attention and bidirectional query–latent cross-attention layers, preserving relative 3D positional cues.
After several blocks,
the query and latent tokens are refined into instance-aware representations.
Note that,
the number of queries K K is significantly smaller than the number of latent cells L lat L_{\text{lat}} and DINOv3 features h × w h\times w ,
so the query self-attention and other cross-attention operations are efficient and scalable to complex scenes with many objects and high-resolution latents.
See section A.1 for block diagram and positional encoding details.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. We assess our model on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
For synthetic data,
we use 3D-FRONT [ 11 ] and MetaScenes [ 83 ] ,
which provide complete per-object meshes and layouts.
For 3D-FRONT,
we filter the InstPIFU [ 34 ] test split and retain 85 high-quality scenes for evaluation;
for MetaScenes,
we analogously select 50 high-quality scenes.
Each synthetic scene is evaluated from one input image.
Furthermore,
to further assess the cross-dataset generalization ability,
we directly evaluate all models on real-world datasets,
including Replica [ 56 ] and ScanNet++ [ 81 ] .
For real-world evaluation, we use more challenging scan-derived scenes with reliable ground truth:
8 scenes / 14 images from Replica and 45 scenes / 56 images from ScanNet++.

Metrics. For quantitative results,
we normalize predicted and ground-truth point clouds and align them with FilterReg before evaluation,
following [ 16 , 39 ] .
Then,
we sample 20,480 points per object mesh and report Chamfer Distance (CD), F-Score (threshold 0.1), and 3D bounding-box IoU at two levels.
At the scene level ,
we assemble all predicted objects and compare the full scene with the ground truth;
at the object level , we compute the same metrics and average over matched objects.
We additionally report per-scene inference time on a single NVIDIA L40S 48 GB GPU, averaging the two datasets in each main table and providing per-dataset timings in Supp. table 5 .

Baselines. We compare with six strong recent single-image scene generation and decomposition baselines:
the per-scene optimization method Gen3DSR [ 1 ] ,
and feed-forward methods including MIDI [ 16 ] , SceneGen [ 39 ] , PartCrafter [ 30 ] , SAM 3D [ 6 ] , and 3D-Fixer [ 82 ] .
To further evaluate the merit of our query-based latent decomposition,
we replace our query transformer with Point-SAM [ 91 ] :

For mask-based methods, we provide ground-truth masks as in prior works [ 16 , 39 , 6 ] ;
for point-based methods, we randomly sample one point from each ground-truth object.
All baselines use their public checkpoints .

blocks.en: 4.2 Assessing Composable Reconstruction on Synthetic Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.2 评估合成场景的可混合重建

blocks.en:
We report results on the 3D-FRONT InstPIFU split and MetaScenes in table 1 .
All three CoLa3D variants surpass the previous per-object generation baselines by a large margin at the scene level,
while achieving strong object-level performance across all three query types.
On 3D-FRONT, CoLa3D (Free) reduces scene CD by 27.9% and improves object F-Score by 8.8% over the best baseline.
On MetaScenes, CoLa3D (Point) reduces scene CD by 57.1% and improves object F-Score by 26.9% over the best baseline.
The averaged Time column shows that CoLa3D (Free) is also around 2 × 2\times faster than the feed-forward baselines,
due to its joint decomposition in a global latent space.
blocks.zh:
我们在表1中报告3D-FRONT InstPIFU分裂和MetaScens的结果。
所有三种CoLa3D变体在场景水平上都大大地超过了先前的每个物体生成基线,
,同时在所有三种查询类型中实现强对象级性能.
在3D-FRONT上,CoLa3D(Free)将场景CD减少27.9%,并将对象F-Score比最佳基线提高8.8%.
在MetaScenes上,CoLa3D(Point)将场景CD减少57.1%,并将对象F-Score比最佳基准提高26.9%.
平均时间栏显示CoLa3D(自由)也比向导基线快2×2\时左右,
由于它在全球潜在空间中的联合分解。

blocks.en:
The qualitative results in fig. 3 further illustrate the advantages of our latent decomposition paradigm.
MIDI and Gen3DSR often generate wrong shapes (first, second, and last rows) when the object is heavily occluded,
while SceneGen and SAM 3D produce more accurate shapes but suffer from spatial inconsistency and interpenetration (third and last rows),
especially when the two objects are in close contact (last row).
CoLa3D shows no such artifacts and produces more coherent layouts and plausible object scales,
even under heavy occlusion,
suggesting that its joint decomposition in a shared 3D latent space leads to more physically plausible and spatially consistent reconstructions.

MIDI和Gen3DSR经常在对象被严重占用时产生错误的形状(第一行,第二行和最后一行),
虽然SceneGen和SAM 3D产生更准确的形状,但受到空间不一致和相通(第三行和最后一行)的影响,
特别是当两个物体紧密相通时(最后一行).
CoLa3D没有显示这种文物,并产生更连贯的布局和可信的物体尺度,
即便在被包围的重地,
表明其共同分解在共享的3D潜在空间中会导致在物理上更合理和更在空间上一致的重建。

blocks.en: 4.4 Assessing Scalability to Denser Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.4 评估可扩展性

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the scalability of CoLa3D to denser and more complex scenes by extending both the training data and query capacity.
To this end,
we augment our original training set with ARSG-110K [ 82 ] , a large-scale scene dataset introduced by 3D-Fixer that contains over 110k scenes and 3M annotated images with object-level geometry and layout annotations.
After data cleaning, we retain 100k ARSG scenes and 870k images, with at most 20 objects per scene.
Using the combined training set, we retrain all three CoLa3D variants for 120k steps with K max = 20 K_{\max}{=}20 , keeping the remaining training settings unchanged.

我们通过扩大培训数据和查询能力,进一步评估CoLa3D的可扩展性,使之更密集和更复杂的场景。
为此,
我们用 ARSG-110K [82] 来增强我们最初的训练集,这是由 3D-Fixer 引入的大型场景数据集,包含超过 110k 场景和 3M 附加注释的图像,带有对象级几何和布局说明.
在数据清理后,我们保留了100克ARSG场景和870克图像,每个场景最多有20个物体.
使用组合训练集,我们重新训练了所有三个CoLa3D变体,共120k步,由K max = 20 K max }{=}20来进行,其余训练设置保持不变.

We retain the other filtering criteria used for the main benchmark to ensure reliable reference geometry.
We report CD, F-Score, and bounding-box IoU at both the scene and object levels, measuring the fidelity of the assembled reconstruction and its constituent objects.

blocks.en: 4.5 Assessing Visible Depth Accuracy

blocks.en:
An ideal composable real-to-simulation 3D generation and decomposition should not only produce high-quality object meshes, but also preserve the overall scene geometry and layout.
To evaluate this aspect,
we assess the visible-region depth accuracy of reconstructed meshes on 3D-FRONT.
To this end,
we render 512 × \times 512 depth maps from reconstructed meshes and compare them against ground-truth depth.
In addition to the 3D reconstruction baselines, we include MoGe2 [ 70 ] , a state-of-the-art monocular depth estimator, as a strong reference.
We report scale-and-shift aligned absolute relative error (AbsRel), RMSE, and δ 1 \delta_{1} (the fraction of valid pixels with relative depth ratio below 1.25) on visible foreground pixels, together with completion, which measures the fraction of ground-truth foreground pixels covered by valid rendered depth.

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.6 读取研究

blocks.en:
We ablate CoLa3D along two axes: decomposition design choices and object-query type.
All variants are trained solely on the 3D-FRONT InstPIFU train split using a single H100 GPU, with all other training hyperparameters held identical.
The learnable-query variant serves as the prompt-free baseline, and each row in table 4 (b) changes one component or query modality.
blocks.zh:
我们沿着两个轴子放弃了CoLa3D:分解设计选择和对象-query类型.
所有变体都完全在3D-FRONT InstPIFU列车使用单个H100 GPU进行分解训练,所有其他训练超参数都保持了相同的状态.
可学习的-query变体充当了即时的基线,表4(b)中的每一行都会改变一个组件或查询方式.

blocks.en:
Importance of Feature Augmentation Feature augmentation is important because latent decomposition must distinguish object extent inside a shared scene representation, not only preserve the global scene shape.
Removing DINOv3 features drops object IoU by 0.0197 0.0197 , while removing Utonia increases object CD by 54.7 % 54.7\% over the learnable-query baseline.
blocks.zh:
特征增强的重要性 地貌增强很重要,因为潜在的分解必须区分共享场景代表中的对象范围,而不仅是保存全球地貌外观.
删除 DINOv3 特性使对象 IoU 下降 0.0197 0.0197 ,而去除 Utonia 则使对象 CD 比可学习-平滑基线增加 54.7% 54.7% 。

blocks.en:
Ablations on Loss Design The multi-hot mask supervision and query diversity loss are significant for improving decomposition quality.
We investigate them by removing the diversity loss and replacing multi-hot supervision with single-hot labels.
The former variant drops object IoU by 3.1 % 3.1\% ,
while the latter reduces object IoU by 5.0 % 5.0\% .

损失设计费用 多热口罩监督和查询多样性损失对于提高分解质量具有重大意义.
我们通过消除多样性的丧失和用单热标签取代多热监督来调查它们。
原变体将对象IoU降为 3.1% 3.1% \%,
而后者则将对象IoU减少5.0% 5.0\%.

blocks.en:
Ablations on Query Type Our query-based decomposition design is flexible to various query types.
The mask variant achieves the best scene-level performance (scene CD reduced by 6.9 % 6.9\% ),
while the point variant achieves the best object-level performance (object CD reduced by 15.1 % 15.1\% over learnable queries),
suggesting that explicit prompts further improve decomposition quality.
blocks.zh:
查询类型上的误差 我们基于查询的分解设计对各种查询类型是灵活的.
口罩变体实现最佳场景级别性能(场景CD减少6.9% 6.9分),

说明明确促进进一步提高分解质量。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en:
We present CoLa3D,
a novel paradigm for Composable Latent 3D decomposition.
Our approach departs from the common recipe of segmenting objects in 2D and reconstructing each one separately, by performing decomposition directly in a whole -scene latent space.
It achieves state-of-the-art results in both object quality and scene-level consistency across various datasets,
in a significantly faster manner.
Our simple, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer also supports various query types and latent sources.
It also achieves visible-region depth accuracy on par with strong depth estimators such as MoGe2,
which is another benefit over per-object generation methods.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍CoLa3D,
用于编译Latement 3D分解的一种新颖范式.
我们的方法偏离了将物体分入2D并分别重建的共同方法,直接在一整片地潜入空间进行分解。
它在各种数据集的物体质量和场景一致性方面都取得了最先进的成果,
以更快的速度进行
我们的简单、灵活和可扩展的基于查询的变压器也支持各种查询类型和潜在来源。
它还与MoGe2等强深度估计器一样,实现了可见区域深度精确度。
这是对每个物体生成方法的另一个好处。

blocks.en:
Limitations and future work. The coarse latent grid can absorb thin or tightly clustered objects into one cell; a hierarchical latent is a natural remedy.
Training data is also a bottleneck: available scene datasets are small in scale, limited in quality, and sparsely populated with objects. Scaling to larger, higher-quality, and more densely populated data is an important next step.
blocks.zh:
限制和今后的工作。 粗细的潜在网格可以将薄薄或紧凑的物体吸收入一个细胞;分级的潜在是自然补救.
训练数据也是一个瓶颈:现有场景数据集规模小,质量有限,有物体的人烟稀少. 向更大、质量更高和人口密度更高的数据扩展是下一步的一个重要步骤。

blocks.en: A.1 Attention Block Details

blocks.en:
This section expands the Attention Blocks component of section 3.2 .
As shown in fig. 5 , each block maintains two information streams:
object queries, which represent instance hypotheses, and 3D scene-latent tokens, which preserve the geometric support of the reconstructed scene.
The block first applies self-attention over the query tokens so that different object hypotheses can exchange context before being grounded in visual evidence.
The queries and latent tokens then both cross-attend to the frozen DINOv3 image features, using image features as keys and values.
This step injects 2D semantic cues into both streams while keeping the 3D latent tokens anchored to the shared scene coordinate frame.

The query stream first attends to the latent-conditioned evidence, allowing each query to refine the spatial extent of its object hypothesis.

Stacking these blocks gradually turns generic queries into object-specific tokens and enriches the scene latent with instance-level cues, which is the representation used by the final assignment head in section 3.2 .

blocks.en: A.2 Training Data Processing
blocks.zh: A.2 培训数据处理

blocks.en:
We derive multi-hot part supervision from the multi-object O-Voxel representation before encoding.
Each object is represented by its active O-Voxel cells with a contiguous instance index, and cells from all objects are merged by high-resolution spatial coordinates instead of being forced into a single object label.
When multiple objects share a coordinate, their instance labels are accumulated into an object-channel multi-hot vector, while geometric attributes are merged by averaging vertex offsets and OR-aggregating intersection indicators; single-object coordinates naturally reduce to one-hot labels.
Because mask prediction is performed after the O-Voxel encoder, we project these full-resolution multi-hot labels to the latent sparse grid using the encoder downsampling ratio, which is 16 × 16\times for the → 64 1024\!\rightarrow\!64 grid compression in our implementation, and use channel-wise OR to aggregate labels within each latent cell.
The resulting target allows one active latent token to supervise multiple object channels at contact or overlapping regions; the predicted per-query sigmoid masks are then matched to these object masks and trained with multi-label BCE and per-object Dice losses as described in section 3.3 .

blocks.en:
We construct evaluation sets from both synthetic datasets, 3D-FRONT [ 11 ] and MetaScenes [ 83 ] , and real-world scan datasets, Replica [ 56 ] and ScanNet++ v2 [ 81 ] .
For the main benchmarks, we retain scenes or views with 2–8 visible objects and exclude samples with severe object collisions, unreliable segmentations, or low-quality ground-truth meshes, so that the metrics reflect reconstruction quality rather than invalid evaluation geometry.
For MetaScenes-hard, the separate 50-scene test set used for the scalability evaluation in section 4.4 , we retain scenes with 9–20 visible objects while applying the other filtering criteria unchanged.

我们从合成数据集、3D-FRONT[11]和MetaScens[83]以及现实世界扫描数据集、复制[56]和ScanNet++v2[81]中构建评价集。
对于主要基准,我们保留了带有2-8个可见物体的场景或观点,并排除了有严重物体相撞、不可靠的分块或低质量地基真人膜的样本,以便衡量标准反映重建质量而不是无效的评价几何。
对于MetaScenes-hard来说,在4.4节中用于可扩展性评价的单独50-场景测试集,我们保留了带有9–20可见对象的场景,同时不加修改地应用了其他过滤标准.

blocks.en:
3D-FRONT. 3D-FRONT [ 11 ] is a large-scale synthetic indoor-scene dataset of professionally designed furnished rooms, with semantic layouts and textured 3D furniture models.
Its complete object meshes and layouts make it suitable for evaluating scene-level geometry and object-level decomposition.
We start from the 3D-FRONT test split provided by InstPIFU [ 34 ] and apply the common filtering protocol above, resulting in 85 high-quality scenes.

其完整的物体间质和布局使其适合评价场景级几何和物体级分解.
我们从InstPIFU[34]提供的3D-FRONT测试分拆开始,并应用上面的通用过滤协议,从而产生了85个高质量的场景.

blocks.en:
MetaScenes. MetaScenes [ 83 ] is a large-scale, simulatable 3D scene dataset built for automated replica creation from real-world indoor scans.
It combines scan-derived layouts with clean object assets and physically plausible scene optimization, providing synthetic scenes with more realistic arrangements.
We randomly sample camera views from the full scene set, render input images, filter the rendered samples with the same protocol as 3D-FRONT, and randomly select 50 high-quality scenes for evaluation.

blocks.en:
For Learnable queries, the initial multi-hot assignment may still contain redundant queries or spatially incoherent predictions,
so we apply a lightweight two-step refinement at inference time.
We first merge redundant queries that describe the same object via greedy non-maximum suppression,
fusing any pair whose mask intersection-over-union exceeds 0.5 0.5 .
We then extract the 6-connected components of each instance over the sparse latent grid and reassign small fragments to neighboring instances by majority vote,
removing isolated noise while preserving compact small objects.

blocks.zh: 附录C 宽度 影响

blocks.en:
CoLa3D turns a single image or a holistic scene mesh into an editable, object-level 3D scene in a single forward pass.
On the positive side, this lowers the barrier to producing simulation-ready 3D environments and can benefit downstream applications such as robotics and embodied-AI training, physically plausible simulation, AR/VR experiences, digital twins, and 3D content creation for games, film, and design.
By decomposing scenes directly in a shared latent space, our method also removes the need for per-object reconstruction and post-hoc layout regression, which makes such tools more accessible to researchers and practitioners with limited compute.
blocks.zh:
CoLa3D将单个图像或整体场景网格转换为可编辑的,在单个前行传中的对象级3D场景.
在积极的一面,这降低了制造模拟准备的3D环境的障碍,并有利于下游的应用,如机器人和已体现的-AI培训、物理上可信的模拟、AR/VR经验、数字双胞胎,以及游戏、电影和设计的3D内容创建。
通过将场景直接分解在一个共享的潜伏空间中,我们的方法也消除了每个对象重建的需要以及后热布局回归的需要,这使得这些工具更容易被研究者和实践者使用,计算有限.

blocks.en:
On the negative side, stronger composable 3D reconstruction tools may be misused to fabricate realistic but fake environments, or to reconstruct private interior spaces from casually captured images without consent, raising potential privacy, copyright, and disinformation concerns.
The model also inherits biases from its training data: scene datasets are dominated by certain categories of indoor furniture and room layouts, so generation and decomposition quality may be uneven across cultures, building styles, and underrepresented object categories.
We encourage downstream users to respect dataset licenses, obtain consent before reconstructing private spaces, and follow applicable privacy and safety requirements when integrating such 3D reconstruction tools into user-facing products.
blocks.zh:
在消极方面,较强的可堆肥的立体重建工具可能会被滥用来编造现实而假的环境,或者在未经同意的情况下从随意捕获的图像中重建私人室内空间,从而引起潜在的隐私、版权和虚假问题。
该模型还继承了来自其培训数据的偏差:场景数据集由某些类别的室内家具和房间布局所主导,因此生成和分解的质量可能因文化,建筑风格,以及代表性不足的物体类别而不平衡.
我们鼓励下游用户尊重数据集许可证,在重建私人空间之前获得同意,并在将这些立体重建工具纳入用户产品时遵循适用的隐私和安全要求。
